review.imagery: Twenty project renders were visually reviewed. Fifteen native brochure scenes and five distinct/wider current-gallery views cover the tower, home interiors, lobby, shared pool, exercise spaces, court, mini golf, spa and outdoor cinema. The complete building exterior supplies the card and hero. Duplicate panorama resources, water textures and generic people photographs are excluded. Proposed interiors remain unit-unspecific. No dated construction photography or card badges.
review.floorPlans: Five complete home drawings come from the official brochure. Three building sheets come from a Mitchell’s Commercial Realty mirror of the SAMANA-branded floorplate pack. Numerical unit areas and home-to-floor keys are absent. The two-bedroom drawing includes a maid room. Confirm the approved unit, configuration and contractual area with SAMANA. All five complete home sheets on physical pages 37–41 were visually reviewed, including the rooms omitted from their shortened titles. All three mirror floorplates on pages 2–4 and the branded cover were reviewed. Their unit keys and floor ranges remain visible without inventing a mapping to the five generic home drawings. Primary minimum areas are not assigned to a specific layout.
review.location: Complete official brochure regional map page 8 and travel panel page 9 were visually reviewed. The Downtown conflict is preserved rather than silently choosing the faster table value. The official q value 25.03923770673877, 55.19303990128905 is saved with source hash and six-place rounding. No road distance, live route or precise entrance is inferred.
review.provenance: Fresh primary HTML and original official brochure retain receipts, original bytes and SHA-256 values. The supplementary floorplate pack is honestly labeled as a Mitchell’s Commercial Realty broker mirror. The brochure’s page 30 copy names Barari Lagoons, so that generic lifestyle page supplies no project-specific media claim. Native image origins, complete sheets and physical PDF links remain available. Protected text research is preserved.

unavailable: Numerical drawing-specific unit areas, approved home-to-floor applicability, resolution of the Downtown time conflict, final fitout, a verified visitor entrance and dated construction photographs were not established.
